_how_to_add: Add a record here to watch a new brand: key = the name inside its web address, domains = its real addresses (first one is shown as 'the real site'), words = how a message names it. Check each domain on its live site first. Then run python test_rules.py and python evaluate.py.
_fields: aliases and no_typo = match when exact or hidden, but never as 'one typo away' or 'looks similar', because too many real sites are that close (counted on the Tranco top 1M). weak and weak_aliases = names that are also ordinary words: they only match with nothing but scam words around them.
